6901949.name: ISEJ Central - Jabad
6901949.note: 'Se iniciaron la clases de ISEJ, el Instituto Superior de Estudios Judaicos, con mas de 15 sedes en todo el país, que abrió este año para brindar a los jóvenes en edad universitaria la oportunidad de conectarse con sus raíces' (Itón Gadol, 10 April 2006: so it opened between January and April 2006, all in 5766). 'Chabad-Lubavitch Rabbi Yoel Migdal, director of Isej, the Superior Institute for Jewish Learning in Buenos Aires' (CrownHeights.info from Chabad.org, Dec 2007); 'El proyecto empezó con 20 o 30 alumnos en un aula' (Migdal, Itón Gadol, Dec 2013). Its central seat is Agüero 1164 (Jabad Argentina's list). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2025-06-09.

477132.name: Beit Jabad Olleros
477132.note: 'Un Beit Jabad muy alegre: Una entrevista con el Rabino Yanki Birman director del Beit Jabad Olleros y 17 años de labor' (jabad.tv, Jabad Argentina's video site, 27 Feb 2018, post 8269): so about 2001 (counted back, medium). In Jabad Argentina's 2010 list: 'BEIT JABAD OLLEROS, Director: Rabino Ianki Birman, Olleros 2028' (no date). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-02-14.

119275.name: Machon Or Chaya
119275.note: 'Enamoradas del judaísmo: «Or Jaia» cumple 19 años de tarea educativa y a modo de balance de gestión, dialogamos con su directora, Jani Gorowicz' (jabad.tv, 28 Jan 2014, post 8645): so about 1995 (counted back, medium). 'MAJÓN OR JAIA. Centro de estudios exlusivo para jóvenes judías. Directora: Jani Gorowitz. Ecuador 574' (Jabad Argentina's list, 2010). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

extra-argentina-fundacion.name: La Fundación de Jabad
extra-argentina-fundacion.note: La Fundación de Jabad, Chabad of Argentina's social-action foundation: 'Hemos asistido desde el año 1989 a más de 15.000 personas y en la actualidad cerca de 2.000 personas son beneficiarias directas de nuestros programas' (its director to Itón Gadol, 25 March 2015); it opened its Javaia and second programs in 2006 and a dental clinic about 2010; its building 'Zully Goldfard' (shared with Ieladeinu), Tucumán 3238, was inaugurated on 12 April 2011 (Itón Gadol, April 2011). (A jabad.tv program posted in March 2015 is titled '23 años de amor y solidaridad'.) Not on chabad.org.

3949545.name: MitzvahTank Argentina
3949545.note: 'Este año, tras el enorme éxito de los dos proyectos anteriores, Jabad Lubavitch impulsa nuevamente un proyecto de inclusión que busca alcanzar a los judíos de toda la Argentina' (Itón Gadol, 7 Aug 2017, on its August tour of the provinces): its third tour, so about 2015 (counted back, medium). The department of Jabad Argentina for the towns without a Beit Jabad, run by Ari Sigaloff (Itón Gadol, Dec 2018; COLlive, May 2019). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2018-12-30.

577218.name: Beit Chabad Congreso - Chabad House for Tourists
577218.note: Chabad's house for Israeli backpackers in Buenos Aires: 'In addition to the one in Salvador, new Chabad centers have opened in Cusco, Peru; Buenos Aires and Bariloche, Argentina' (lubavitch.com, 5 Nov 2006, on Chabad houses for Israeli backpackers). Medium: the article does not name it, but it is Buenos Aires' one such house: 'BEIT JABAD LAMETAIEL, Chabad House fot tourist, Adolfo Alsina 1488/92' (Jabad Argentina's list, 2010; now 'Beit Jabad Congreso y para israelíes, Moreno 1276'). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-10-09.

1988058.name: Beit Jabad Floresta Norte
1988058.note: Jabad reopened 'el antiguo templo de la calle Cervantes 1034, del barrio de Flores, que estuvo cerrado por más de diez años', the only synagogue of Flores Norte (Floresta); Rabbi David Plotka of Beit Jabad Flores took charge, and 'hace seis semanas que se realizan las ceremonias de Shabat' (Itón Gadol, 9 Sept 2011): from late July 2011, Av 5771. Medium: that it is this listing is inferred: Cervantes 1034 is Flores' annex in Floresta (Jabad Argentina's list), and Chabadpedia has Rabbi Dovid Plotka's son Rabbi Shneur Zalman Plotka as shliach in Floresta. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2012-10-21.

119823.name: Oholey Chinuch Girls School
119823.note: Rabbi Tzvi Grunblatt, who came in 1978: 'A month later, after we arrived, a few parents came to ask, asking us we should start a, a, a girls' seminary, a high school ... Why don't we should open a, a, a high school for the girls? Fifteen girls. I wrote in to the Rebbe' (the 'Bein Chassidim' podcast, episode 62, transcript, 5786). Medium: a girls' high school begun in 1978; that today's girls' school (Escuela Oholey Jinuj Nenas, Boulogne Sur Mer 626) grew from it is inferred. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

3407840.name: Beit Jabad San Fernando - Tigre
3407840.note: Not in Jabad Argentina's list of July 2010 (Wayback copy); in its later list 'BEIT JABAD SAN FERNANDO – TIGRE, Director: Rabino Moshé Abudarham, Constitución 1470' (email at bjzn.org, Beit Jabad Zona Norte's domain). 'Una charla con el Rabino Moshe Abudharam, Director del Beit Jabad San Fernando, quien nos cuenta acerca de los primeros pasos de esta nueva comunidad' (jabad.tv, 31 July 2014): so about 2010-2014. Its first Sefer Torah came in Sept 2017 (Itón Gadol). Radio Jai (July 2020) has him rabbi of Beit Jabad San Fernando 'desde hace más de 16 años', which may count his years with Zona Norte. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2016-08-17.

3106002.name: Beit Jabad Barracas
3106002.note: 'The Chabad representative to Barracas' Rabbi Shneor Mizrahi found La Boca's 1907 synagogue Knesset Israel, held by a squatter, 'six years ago' (lubavitch.com, Sept 2019), and had been working on it 'hace 5 años'; 'Hace 1 año se mudó a la Boca con la misión de ocuparse de la Sinagoga Rocha' (Itón Gadol, Aug 2019). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2015-10-27; today Rocha 1467. No start found: by 2015, perhaps 2013.

5694906.name: Aieka Jewish Teen Center
5694906.note: 'AIEKA: Experiencias y Vivencias. Aieka el centro de actividades para adolescentes de 15 a 18 años realiza un viaje a New York todos los años' (jabad.tv, 12 April 2015, post 9073); with Rabbi Ionatan Sirota (Itón Gadol, Jan 2020). Bartolomé Mitre 4390. No start found; by 2015. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2022-11-08.

117745.name: Chabad Lubavitch Argentina HQ
117745.note: 'Antes de afincarse en Buenos Aires, al ser designado Shliaj (enviado) del Rebe, el rabino Dovber Baumgarten z'l efectuó una gira por diversos países latinoamericanos en el año 1955, y se estableció en Buenos Aires en 1957' (Itón Gadol, 7 March 2018, at a tribute to him). Chabadpedia's Argentina page: he worked there for the summer months before, and 'רק בשנת תשי"ח קבע בה את מגוריו והביא אליה את משפחתו' (only in 5718 did he settle there and bring his family; his own page has him settling in Cheshvan 5723). Chabad.org counts his work 'from 1955' (CrownHeights.info's copy, Dec 2023). Rabbi Tzvi Grunblatt came in 1978 to take his place (the head shliach since). Agüero 1164. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22. Jabad Argentina marked its 50 years in 2008-09: 'Video institucional dedicado a los primeros 50 años de labor comunitaria de Jabad en Argentina' (jabad.tv, Nov 2009).

117924.name: Beit Jabad Flores
117924.note: 'היאחזות חב"ד בשכונה החלה בממדים צנועים בשנת תשנ"ב, כאשר הרב דוד פלאטקא החל לשמש בה שליח. בית-חב"ד שהקים שכן בדירה קטנה ושכורה, אך בשנת תשנ"ד התרחבה הקהילה ורכשה את בית-חב"ד הנוכחי' (Chabad in the neighbourhood began modestly in 5752, when Rabbi Dovid Plotka started as its shliach, in a small rented apartment; in 5754 the community bought its house) (COL, 4 Jan 2004, at the inauguration of its new building, a copy of 770). Chabadpedia (his page) agrees: in 5752, with the Rebbe's blessing, a Chabad house opened in Flores. His sons run Flores Norte (Andrés Lamas), Floresta and Or Sinai. Jabad Argentina's list of its centers: 'Establecido: Elul 5752 – Septiembre de 1992. Inauguración Sede: Elul 5754 -Septiembre de 1994. Helguera 634'. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22. 'Un Beit Jabad mayor de edad' (jabad.tv, Oct 2010: 18 years).

earlier.where: a small rented apartment in Flores (5752-5754)

117747.name: Beit Jabad Rosario
117747.note: 'Llegamos a Rosario como emisarios del Rebe de Lubavich para fundar Beit Jabad Rosario. Mi señora Jaia Sarah Dahan yo, Shlomo Tawil, junto a mi hija Jana de 3 meses en Febrero de 1987 ... En 1988 se colocó la piedra fundamental para nuestra sede. En 1992 se inauguró la mikve y en 1994 se inauguró el resto del edificio' (AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory, text from the kehilá; Mendoza 1572). Also 'When Tawil arrived with his wife Chaya Sara in 1987 to establish a Chabad presence' (lubavitch.com, Sept 2005) and 'he has served as the Chabad emissary in Rosario since 1987' (COLlive and CrownHeights.info, June 2019). A branch in Puerto Norte is run by Rabbi Mendi Tawil. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22. Jabad Argentina's list of its centers: 'Establecido: Shvat 5747 – Febrero 1987. Inauguración Sede: Elul 5754 – Septiembre 1994'. '25º Aniversario: Un clip institucional sobre la fructífera labor del Beit jabad de Rosario' (jabad.tv, Aug 2012).

1037533.name: Escuela y Comunidad Wolfsohn Tabacinic
1037533.note: The Wolfsohn School, 'a former flagship school of Argentina's Conservative Jewish movement, which opened this week under the auspices of Chabad-Lubavitch': 'On March 7, the beginning of the academic year in Buenos Aires and only a few months since Chabad stepped in, the newly renovated building now named the Tabicinik Center for Jewish Studies—Wolfsohn School opened with 150 students' (lubavitch.com, 11 March 2005). Wolfsohn itself 'was founded in 1906 as a Jewish community library' and was the Conservative movement's flagship school until 2004; Rabbi Mendy Gurevitch and his wife came to lead its community in 2011 (CrownHeights.info, June 2015). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2009-11-10. '10 años de logros ... alusivo al 10ª aniversario de este nuevo proyecto' (jabad.tv, July 2014).

119276.name: Beit Jabad Or Sinai
119276.note: 'También en Palermo funciona desde noviembre pasado un centro de estudios de Torá y Cábala con cursos dirigidos por el rabino Pinjas Sudry ... Si bien el proyecto del Instituto de Torá y Cábala Or Sinai es nuevo, se viene gestando desde hace algunos años' (Itón Gadol, 9 Dec 2007); 'Nosotros empezamos hace 8 años en una mesa con cuatro alumnos' (Rabbi Sudry, Itón Gadol, April 2016, as it moved to a new building in Barrio Norte). 'Or Sinai 10 años' (jabad.tv, 31 Jan 2018). Medium: its chabad.org listing number is from the directory's first upload (2004-07-22), so the listing may once have been another center's. Now Vidt 1982. Its earliest archived listing page (Aug 2009) is already 'Centro de Tora y Kabala Or Sinai'.

117743.name: Editorial Kehot Lubavitch Sudamericana
117743.note: 'El Rabino Natán Grunblatt, Director de Editorial Kehot nos cuenta sobre el desarrollo de está editorial durante sus jóvenes 20 años de existencia' (jabad.tv, 23 Oct 2011) and 'Un institucional sobre los veinte años de la editorial Kehot Sudamericana' (jabad.tv, Dec 2011; a recital of Avraham Fried was held for its 20th anniversary): so about 1991 (counted back, medium). Chabadpedia (his page, no footnote) has an earlier start: 'בשנת תשמ"ב פתח הרב גרינבלאט סניף קה"ת' (a Kehot branch in 5742, 1981-82). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.
